4521.title: Claude Code ask requests are auto allowed
4521.rootCauseOneLine: The Claude Code bridge ignores the SDK ask-rule marker and auto allows permission callbacks that lack optional explanation fields.
4521.proposedFix: Honor explicit ask rules and fail closed for metadata-free permission callbacks while preserving deliberate bypass and escalation policy.
4521.caveats: Bridge callback reproduced twice; a live Claude settings and external hook run was not performed.
